items.title: Interactive refactors land in gopls
items.oneliner: gopls now supports multi-step refactors in editors, making complex Go code transformations practical inside VS Code today.

items.title: Themeable Mermaid rendering gets fast
items.oneliner: This library renders Mermaid diagrams as SVG up to 500 times faster, with CSS theming and no heavy runtime.

items.title: Cheap web search and fetch APIs
items.oneliner: DeepSeek exposes installable search and fetch APIs that return live results and Markdown pages for $0.75 per 1000 requests.

items.title: Regex behavior becomes visually debuggable
items.oneliner: Interactive 3D regex visualizer shows backtracking, greedy loops, and match flow so you can debug patterns faster.

items.title: Open micromanipulator reaches nanometer motion
items.oneliner: Open-source 3D motion platform delivers roughly 50 nm steps with USB G-code control for optics, probing, and microscopy.

items.title: Lua gets practical static typing
items.oneliner: Teal adds TypeScript-style type checking to Lua and compiles back to plain Lua for safer existing codebases.

items.title: C++ condition variables explained correctly
items.oneliner: Hands-on guide shows why notify-before-wait breaks, and how predicate waits prevent subtle C++ threading deadlocks.

items.title: Parser combinators from first principles
items.oneliner: Concrete tutorial builds reusable parsers step by step, covering sequencing, mapping, whitespace, and error handling.

items.title: ARP troubleshooting becomes approachable
items.oneliner: Practical networking walkthrough explains ARP with arp-scan examples, spoofing pitfalls, and packet-level intuition for debugging LAN issues.

items.title: Debugging DNS propagation systematically
items.oneliner: Detailed post shows how to instrument DNS propagation failures with real debugger output, state inspection, and failure-mode analysis.
